title: Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning for Code Comprehension
abstract: arXiv:2610.19970v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repository-level code comprehension question answering (QA) supports developer reasoning over functionality and usage distributed across codebases. However, repository-specialized large language models (LLMs) can become misaligned as code evolves. We study this challenge as temporal repository adaptation: acquiring new knowledge, suppressing obsolete, retaining still-valid, and preserving semantically neighboring knowledge. Existing retrieval, fine-tuning, and model-editing methods address only parts of this problem. We propose Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning (TAFT), a novel adaptation approach that treats repository transitions as supervision. TAFT derives temporally grounded QA data from repository transitions, pairs newly valid with obsolete knowledge through preference optimization, and replays transition-conditioned retention examples to preserve still-valid knowledge. translated_title: 面向代码理解的时间自适应微调
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.19970v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：仓库级代码理解问答支持开发者对分布于代码库中的功能和使用方式进行推理。然而，针对特定仓库的大语言模型（LLM）可能随着代码的演化而变得不再对齐。我们将这一挑战研究为时间性仓库适应问题：获取新知识、抑制过时知识、保留仍然有效的知识，以及维护语义上相近的知识。现有的检索、微调和模型编辑方法只能解决该问题的部分方面。我们提出了时间自适应微调（Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning，TAFT），这是一种新颖的适应方法，它将仓库的演变转换视为监督信号。TAFT 从仓库转换中推导出具有时间依据的问答数据，通过偏好优化将新有效知识与过时知识配对，并重放以转换为条件的保留示例，以维护仍然有效的知识。我们在一个增强的时间化 SWE-bench 数据集上评估了 TAFT……（摘要原文截断）
tldr: 提出 TAFT（时间自适应微调）方法，将仓库代码的演变转换作为监督信号，使大语言模型在代码理解问答中能够获取新知识、抑制过时知识，并保留仍然有效及语义相近的知识。
en_tdlr: TAFT (Temporal Adaptive Fine-Tuning) treats repository transitions as supervision, enabling LLMs to acquire new knowledge, suppress obsolete knowledge, and retain still-valid and semantically neighboring knowledge for temporal code comprehension adaptation.
